signals.name: Back to school (CBSE & North/Central India)
signals.items: school bags, uniforms, school shoes, textbooks, notebooks, tiffin boxes, water bottles
signals.reason: New session starts 1 April for CBSE and most northern/central state boards; buying peaks late Mar to mid Apr

signals.name: Post-summer school reopening (North)
signals.items: replacement uniforms and shoes, raincoats, umbrellas, notebooks
signals.reason: Schools reopen late June-July after the summer break, coinciding with the monsoon (estimate)

signals.name: Back to school (South & West, June session)
signals.items: school bags, uniforms, shoes, textbooks, raincoats, umbrellas, lunch boxes
signals.reason: State-board year starts in June (TN 4 Jun, AP/TS 12 Jun in 2026; Kerala/Karnataka ~1 Jun), overlapping monsoon onset

signals.name: Back to school (West Bengal & NE, Jan-Feb session)
signals.items: bags, uniforms, books, stationery, shoes
signals.reason: WB state schools and several NE boards run a Jan-Dec year (Meghalaya began 9 Feb 2026); Assam/Arunachal/Nagaland estimate

signals.name: Back to school (Mizoram, Manipur, Tripura, April)
signals.items: bags, uniforms, books, shoes
signals.reason: Mizoram's 2026-27 session began 1 Apr (moving to Jan-Dec from 2027-28); Manipur/Tripura April (estimate)

signals.name: Back to school (Kashmir & Ladakh winter zone)
signals.items: bags, books, shoes, warm uniforms
signals.reason: Winter-zone schools reopen late Feb-early Mar after a ~3-month winter vacation

signals.name: Board exam season (CBSE & North boards)
signals.items: pens, geometry sets, sample papers, health drinks, dry fruits, desk lamps
signals.reason: CBSE Class 10/12 run 17 Feb to early Apr 2026; UP, Bihar, Maharashtra, WB and NE boards also Feb-Mar

signals.name: Exam season slows leisure spending
signals.items: entertainment, gaming, family travel, discretionary fashion
signals.reason: Households with Class 10/12 students defer leisure and travel during board exams (estimate)

signals.name: Board exam season (South, Mar-Apr)
signals.items: stationery, study guides, health drinks
signals.reason: Karnataka SSLC 18 Mar-2 Apr 2026; TN/Kerala/AP/TS boards in March (estimate)

signals.name: Results & college admissions
signals.items: laptops, tablets, phones, headphones, luggage, hostel bedding, study tables
signals.reason: Board results Apr-May; CUET/JoSAA/NEET counselling Jun-Aug; Flipkart 'Back to Campus' sale runs in June

signals.name: Hostel move-in (college towns)
signals.items: trolley bags, mattresses, buckets, kettles, induction cooktops, extension boards
signals.reason: Students relocate to college hubs (Delhi, Bengaluru, Pune, Chennai, Hyderabad, Kota) in Jul-Aug (estimate)

signals.name: Competitive exam prep (JEE/NEET/CUET)
signals.items: test-series books, tablets, desk lamps, earphones, health supplements
signals.reason: JEE Main Jan & Apr, NEET 3 May, CUET 11-31 May 2026 (NTA calendar)

signals.name: Coaching-hub student demand
signals.items: study tables, coolers, mini-fridges, induction stoves, books
signals.reason: New coaching batches start Apr-Jul in Kota, Hyderabad, Delhi, Patna, Prayagraj, Latur (estimate)

signals.name: Summer vacation (South & West, Apr-May)
signals.items: luggage, travel bookings, toys, cycles, swimwear, board games
signals.reason: State-board schools close after March exams until the June reopening

signals.name: Summer vacation (North & East, May-Jun)
signals.items: hill-station travel, luggage, toys, summer-camp gear, coolers
signals.reason: Northern schools close mid/late May to end-June; WB/Odisha early May-June

signals.name: Puja vacation (East)
signals.items: travel, new clothes, kids' toys
signals.reason: Schools and colleges close ~2-4 weeks for Durga Puja-Kali Puja (WB colleges 18 Oct-11 Nov 2026)

signals.name: Dasara holidays (AP, Telangana, Karnataka)
signals.items: bus and train travel home, kids' clothes, toys
signals.reason: 10-14 day Dasara/Bathukamma school break, late Sep-Oct (estimate)

signals.name: Diwali vacation (Maharashtra, Gujarat, Goa)
signals.items: family travel, kids' toys, outfits
signals.reason: State-board schools take a ~2-3 week Diwali break after first-term exams (estimate)

signals.name: Onam vacation (Kerala)
signals.items: travel, kids' clothes, toys
signals.reason: ~10-day Onam break after first-term exams (2026 approx 29 Aug-8 Sep)

signals.name: Sankranti/Pongal holidays (South)
signals.items: hometown travel, kites, kids' clothes
signals.reason: AP/TS schools close ~7-10 days for Sankranti; TN Pongal holidays (estimate)

signals.name: Christmas vacation (Kerala, Goa, NE)
signals.items: travel, toys, gifts, winter wear
signals.reason: Kerala schools close ~19-29 Dec; NE (Jan-Dec session) has a year-end vacation

signals.name: North India winter school break
signals.items: winter wear, room heaters, indoor toys and games
signals.reason: Schools close ~1-15 Jan for the cold wave

signals.name: Hill-state long winter vacation
signals.items: heaters, warm wear, indoor entertainment, kids' games
signals.reason: Winter-zone schools shut Dec-Feb (Kashmir classes 1-8: 1 Dec-28 Feb 2026); HP/Uttarakhand hills similar (estimate)

signals.name: CBSE Class 10 second board exam
signals.items: study guides, stationery
signals.reason: Optional improvement phase of CBSE Class 10 boards, 15 May-1 Jun 2026

signals.name: UPSC prelims prep
signals.items: books, tablets, desk lamps, supplements
signals.reason: Aspirant demand peaks before the late-May UPSC prelims in coaching hubs (estimate)
